Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Westminster for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from December 5 (Breakfast with Santa and Santa on the Go) through December 12 (Santa on the Go at Coronet Park and Westminster Park), with the Tree Lighting Ceremony at the Westminster Civic Center (December 7) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Westminster

  • 4 Christmas events for kids in Westminster
  • 2 free events: the Tree Lighting Ceremony and Santa on the Go at Coronet Park
  • Meet Santa: Breakfast with Santa (December 5), Santa on the Go at four city parks (December 5 and 12) and Santa photos at the Tree Lighting Ceremony (December 7)
  • Parades and tree lightings: Tree Lighting Ceremony at the Westminster Civic Center (December 7)
  • Season: December 5 to December 12

Planning a bigger day out? Westminster families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Anaheim, which covers Holidays at the Disneyland Resort, the Nutcracker Holiday Village and Tree Lighting in Downtown Anaheim and Monster Jam Christmas Chaos at Angel Stadium.
